description: A scheme: one kind of organisation identifier (SPEC 5.2, DEC-029). The header fields issuer, jurisdiction, kind, abbreviation, availability, iso6523_icd and peppol_eas are covered by sources.default with certainty certain when written as a bare value; any of them may use the long form { value, source, certainty }, which overrides the default for that field (D-07, D-08). Every statement carries its own source and certainty (DEC-029). label, scope and notes are descriptive text and need no source (D-09).

sources.description: The default source for the bare header fields (D-07). Required even when every header field uses the long form.
